reviews.text: The owner gives moral lectures on Border Terrier grooming, insisting that dogs come to her salon more than twice a year for grooming, even though it's not recommended for their coats. All this out of laziness and to save the salon money, at the expense of wire-haired dogs.

It was the very first time I'd taken Josephine, my cocker spaniel, to a grooming salon. At only 7 months old and quite sensitive, it wasn't easy, but I was welcomed by Caroline who immediately put me at ease and reassured me.

She and her team were incredibly patient! The atmosphere was fantastic, the welcome super warm, and Josephine wasn't stressed at all. The result is perfect! A little bonus: Caroline offers gorgeous accessories 😍
A great place in the 5th arrondissement, thank you for sharing!

Caroline is very passionate about dogs. I’ve been bringing my lakeland terrier to her for 2 years. The standard grooming for a lakeland is very specific and Caroline always does a beautiful job.

She took the time to explain some grooming techniques I could do at home in between appointments. My only complaint is that I wish her salon was closer to me ☺️ I highly recommend her !

After years of loyalty, I had a terrible experience with Caroline on December 11th because our Welsh Terrier wasn't groomed (despite dropping him off at 10 am and picking him up at 2:45 pm!). What were you doing all that time? Complete lack of courtesy! Despite your supposed experience and professionalism.
We had to go to another groomer on January 30th, 2026, for our dog, and there, miraculously, everything was done properly! Thank you, Caroline; no more crossing Paris and waiting four hours!
FOLLOW-UP TODAY'S REPLY... I REPEAT: MY WELSH TERRIER WAS STAYING FOR 4 HOURS AND 45 MINUTES FOR A BROWNING THAT WASN'T DONE, AND THIS COST OVER 100 EUROS! SURELY DUE TO A LACK OF TIME, AS WE HAD AN APPOINTMENT ON TUESDAY THAT YOU MOVED ON TO THURSDAY! BE HONEST AND ADMIT THAT OUR DOG WAS UNAVAILABLE! Because having someone else wax their dog a month and a half after supposedly doing it is not normal! Change your arrogant attitude, Madam Know-It-All... and let's trust our vets rather than your dubious opinions.

Furthermore, we don't need a Welsh specialist because we found excellent groomers in the Paris region and the Var without having to travel far and for less money! Thanks again, Caroline, for opening our eyes! We were incredibly naive, and you took full advantage of it!

Caroline is the best! She's been grooming my Yorkie, Nougatine, for so many years. Having moved from Paris to Normandy, I've remained loyal to Caroline because she's a true pro 🤗
I recommend her grooming services without hesitation!

You can go there with your eyes closed!
See you soon for a pampering session for Nougatine.
Licks from Nougatine 😛

Excellent service. Exceptional work on my Bichon Frise.

I highly recommend them.
THANKS

Excellent grooming salon, I have nothing but praise for the haircuts on my Pomeranian and Dachshund 👌🏼 + the manager gives great advice. And she has a wonderful team to support her.
See you soon! …

The welcome was unpleasant.

The manager thinks she knows everything about dogs.
She didn't take the time to reassure my dog ​​and grabbed him roughly by the scruff of the neck…
Avoid this place… I recommend the one on Rue de la Montagne Sainte Geneviève; they are very welcoming to everyone!

Highly professional! Carolin immediately understood how to groom Twiggy, the Biewer Yorkshire Terrier, who is now very elegant, and also Vorig, the small black Spitz, whose fur was matted by the undercoat. Now she's so light and airy. Well done!
The work was sloppy; I wouldn't go back.

I only came to buy treats. And I was completely ripped off! I don't know if they just make up the price or if everyone gets ripped off, but I paid €10 for a box of treats that only cost €5.95 in other pet shops in Paris!!

And… the cherry on top… I paid in cash because, apparently, card fees are too high for them!!! I hope I've contributed to your dishonest enrichment! Rest assured, I won't be setting foot in your shop again! Goodbye!
Super
The best grooming salon in Paris! Caroline and her team are fantastic! Ten years of loyalty to this Scottish Terrier specialist. Tequila loves it.
I go there to get kibble for my pets, they love it.

A huge thank you to Caroline and her team for our puppy Alba's very first grooming session 🐾

It was an important step for us, and she immediately put us at ease. Caroline was gentle, patient, and very attentive to Alba. You can tell she truly loves animals and takes the time to make them feel comfortable.

Alba came out looking beautiful, all clean, and most importantly, calm for her first experience 🥰

We wholeheartedly recommend Caroline and will definitely be back!

The manager of the establishment had a very bossy tone, bordering on disrespectful, when she spoke to me because I arrived 10-15 minutes before my dog's grooming was finished. She practically rushed me out ("You're leaving now, right? - Go away!"), all accompanied by equally impolite gestures.
Upon reading the reviews for the first time, I realized this was a repeat offense, and that the negative reviews apparently hadn't served to challenge the lack of tact and the normalized disrespect.

NB: The proper management of an establishment certainly relies heavily on quality service, but also on respectful communication and consideration for those who make your business possible. This is definitely the last time I'll set foot in there, and as you so modestly stated in response to a negative review: I'll gladly leave you to take on other dogs... another true professional will take mine. PS: Respect is the foundation of civility, no matter who you're dealing with... happy pondering ;)

My 4 year old teckel had her first grooming session with Au Paradis Canin. We chose to go there because everyone told me it's the only place where I could have her nails trimmed and not be traumatised. All I can say is that my Rosie left with the biggest smile on her face! Thank you so much to the team, we will for sure come back!

A day of immersion at the salon!
A fantastic discovery experience, a very warm welcome. I immediately felt at ease, which allowed me to see the different handling techniques for dogs and cats.
The animals are treated with great care.
I highly recommend this salon for quality training with the necessary rigor for effective learning.
Thank you to Caroline and her team for this wonderful day with you.

A traumatic experience at this salon where I had come to do an internship, hoping to eventually join the salon for training. Initially a bit reserved, the owner literally treated me like an idiot, even suggesting I change my hair color to loosen up! Not all dogs are treated the same. This one has to live up to this woman if he doesn't want to be insulted. The employees eat lunch behind the area where the animals are washed. There's no kitchen. The cleaning is also done entirely by the employees. In short, 25 years later, I haven't forgotten leaving that salon in tears. You are simply odious behind your smiles, Madam.

Thank you to Caroline for taking such good care of Vatina's fur! :) I have complete confidence in Caroline and have always been delighted with the natural cut for my Spitz, who is a true connoisseur of the breed! Thank you to Caroline for always giving me invaluable advice (training, vet, etc.) for Vatina. I recommend her 100%!
Never surprising, Caroline and her team are delivering excellent service
A BIG THANK YOU
Caroline and her team take excellent care of our Westie. A warm welcome and the results are always outstanding!
Thank you 🙏 …
I highly recommend this very pleasant groomer! My dog ​​has never looked so good, perfect cut! 🐕 …

Caroline has been taking care of my dog, Winston, since his first grooming as a puppy. Winston is a Bichon Frise, and his coat is very difficult to maintain (it tends to mat and become knotted very quickly). Caroline was very patient and showed me how to properly comb his hair in between grooming visits. Every time we leave Caroline's salon, Winston looks like a show dog. She does beautiful work. I have never had any issues at this salon and will continue to bring Winston here. Caroline and her team are very friendly and professional. I highly recommend this salon. Thank you!

Caroline has been taking care of my dog, Winston, since his first grooming. Winston is a Bichon Frise, and his coat is very difficult to maintain (it tends to mat). Caroline has been very patient and showed me how to comb him properly between appointments. Winston always looks very handsome when he leaves her salon. In terms of organization and service, I have never had any problems at this salon. Caroline and her team are very warm and professional. I highly recommend this salon. Thanks again!

Thank you Caroline for taking London at the last minute and doing such an incredible job in making her look so beautiful. Your and your team are wonderful...true artists!   We will definitely see you next year when we return to Paris.  X0X0

The best grooming!
Very, very professional.
Impeccable cuts.

The team at Paradis Canin is fantastic; Caroline is charming and very professional. My schnauzer, Uma, has been going there since her first grooming appointment, and her coat looks better every time. Ultimately, you also need to know what you want for your dog and for yourself: Caroline likes to groom according to the highest standards and the breed's best practices. If you want your wiry-haired dog to become curly-haired and your schnauzer to look like a poodle, this is obviously not the right place.
